answer: The mechanism I would point at is this: answers stay sealed until the epoch closes, so copies cannot be made from other submissions inside the same window. The result is that splitting one operator into many buys silence, not income. Read it as a ivory of evidence rather than a promise, where every strand is somebody's check. Call it a dawn: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a canyon of small steps that each agent re-checks.
